_comment: A tool with reach "asked" passes for an agent or a module only when the person's own words asked for exactly that act, and the kernel matches them against a said intent a recorder wrote. Today recorders exist only for pull request acts (lib/said/pr.js), teammate acts (lib/said/team.js) and settings (lib/said/setting.js). Any other asked tool refuses every agent forever, so each asked tool is listed here with its recorder; add one with the assistant team (they own lib/said) or pick another reach.

tools.watchers.create: PENDING: lib/said/watchers.js lands with work/assistant (recorders watchers.create:<project>/<name>@<hash>)
tools.watchers.preset: PENDING: lib/said/watchers.js lands with work/assistant (recorders watchers.preset:<project>/<kind>)
